purpose: No-return structural test of candidate slot admission under identical physical shared accounts; global count cap is the sole arm difference.

gates.M1: Cap6 has directly observed reversal GLOBAL_POSITION_COUNT denials or count-induced unused reversal exposure.
gates.M2: If cap6 candidate global-count denials >=20, cap8 reduces them >=25% relative; otherwise require >=10 fewer events, plus all other gates.
gates.M3: Cap8 reduces reversal count-induced unused target exposure >=25% relative to cap6.
gates.M4: >=10% of eligible reversal equity decision timestamps have a candidate admission state difference attributable specifically to global cap.
gates.M5: Cap8 does not increase V3 or crypto global-count denials; any apparent increase fails pending bookkeeping proof.
gates.M6: Two independent executions per arm produce identical canonical capacity event hashes.
gates.M8: Claims never exceed arm cap; crypto positions <=2; pending SELL never frees a slot early.

materiality_rule: PROVEN only if all prerequisites and M1-M8 pass; NOT_PROVEN only for a valid replay failing M1-M5; BLOCKED for chronology, attribution, parity, causality, determinism, slot or verifier failure.
